name: PhysioTrack A2 - Test All 3 Read Tools (9 checks)

parameters.content:
## A2 sub-workflow integration tests (9 checks)
**Before running:** Open each orange Execute Sub-workflow node and select the matching **already-imported/published** A2 workflow from the Workflow dropdown. The imported JSON cannot know your local workflow IDs.

Each branch calls the actual selected sub-workflow with dev and supplied case-file examples. **Run once for each item** is intentionally set because the A2 Code nodes read `$input.first()`.

Click **Execute workflow** → inspect **FINAL A2 TEST REPORT**: PASS means 9/9 checks pass. If an orange node errors, check the workflow selector and sub-workflow call permissions. No cloud model or real patient data is used.
